verbatim_quotes.text: when you're selling something You can sell the knowledge. Oh, it has amino acid blah blah science science or when you're selling You want to sell the feeling? verbatim_quotes.text: She says that she uses AI. I think she thinks she's already using it optimally but I'm going to challenge her and say that she's probably only using it to 10% of what she could be using it.

verbatim_quotes.text: So I'm going to ask her if she knows what weird means. What does weird mean? Weird, you know that word. That's a good word for you to know so weird.

verbatim_quotes.text: Yucky yucky. Yes, like a word to say like gross like a kid would say that a kid. But we would say like as adults we'd say more like oh that's gross. Or if we want to say it more strong that's disgusting, right disgusting.

verbatim_quotes.text: I'm going to graduate. from University in 2030 Look at how fast AI is improving already right by 2030. AI is going to be able to do a lot of things almost every almost everything it already can so the next few years are going to be very dangerous.
